control_checks.patterns: All sixteen pattern payloads identical, including note primary and auxiliary cells
control_checks.backing_samples: All65536 owner codes and all other sound headers/data identical
control_checks.other_plain_packets: Every packet except the existing Sound3 reference must be identical
control_checks.ownership: Sound3 owner byte remains0; no allocation or sample-content changes

first_field_is_start.expected: Nonzero value smaller than the65536-code backing buffer

second_field_unchanged.interpretation: Candidate length semantics; constant value alone is ambiguous if new start remains below8000

second_field_moves_with_start.interpretation: Alternative endpoint representation preserving the prior raw width

limits: No exact start value is predicted from an approximate physical knob position
Alternative second-field hypotheses are evaluated independently, not treated as simultaneous requirements
A small start with constant second field does not resolve endpoint versus length without further evidence
No nonzero-start sample extractor or writer is enabled by registration
Measured-clock recovery, if needed, must not use the expected fields or a target frame
